purpose: This table is a cleaned lookup of the 16 air carriers that flew out of New York City airports in 2013, per the Bureau of Transportation Statistics, mapping each two-letter carrier_code to its full carrier_name for use as a dimension joined to flight fact tables.
usage: Join downstream flight records to this table on carrier_code to enrich them with the full carrier_name; the table is complete (no nulls) and free of exact duplicate rows, so no pre-filtering is required before joining.
limitations: The lookup reflects a snapshot of 2013 carrier codes only and carries no versioning or effective-date column, so code reassignments over time cannot be tracked; pipeline capture-tool metadata columns (_airbyte_raw_id, _airbyte_extracted_at, _airbyte_meta) were dropped and are unavailable downstream.
